Live: MW4Field camo tracker · Weapon stats: MW4 weapons database · Map: Hajin interactive map Every camo tracker I tried wanted an account first. Sign up, connect your platform, grant permissions, then maybe get a checklist. For a grind that resets every game, that is a lot of commitment for a table of checkboxes. So I took the boring approach: the state lives in the browser, and the site never learns who you are. What it actually does The c...
